context:
Goal: the native Orphaned and Tally screens look like the web, and the native screen tests pass so step 4 can ship.
Problem: Apple's accessibility check says "Contrast failed" on the small bordered buttons (Edit, Discard, Cancel) and, in 2 of 8 runs, on the red "left" line in Tally. Every one of them measures above the 4.5:1 floor. It needs your word because the only ways to green are to skip that check on those few items or change how they look.
Based on: measured contrast, ink on card 12.2, grey ink on card 5.2, red on card 5.5, from two test-app runs of 105+ rows (Restyle's table, measured).
Based on: your ruling of 2026-10-21 that one contrast check was a bad test (read).
Meanwhile: Restyle fixes every cause it can without changing the look (the card shadow and the rest), and keeps building step 4.

designs.label: a) Skip the check: look unchanged
c) Leave it red: look unchanged

holds: Step 4 (Orphaned and Tally restyle) cannot pass its native screen tests or merge.
home: a debt or decision filed by manifest-restyle with step 4

options.gain: The web look stays, and the tests go green.
options.how: Turn off Apple's contrast check for the named small buttons and the Tally "left" line. Each skip points at the measured table. Every other accessibility check stays on.
options.label: Skip the check on those items only
options.lose: Apple's check no longer watches contrast on those few items. The colour tests still pin their ratios.

options.how: Make the small-button text 15pt, or drop its border.
options.label: Change the look
options.lose: The phone's small buttons look bigger or plainer than the web's.

options.how: Keep the check failing and record it as a known gap.
options.label: Leave it red
options.lose: Step 4 can't report a passing test run.

title: Apple's accessibility check flags text you can read clearly, so step 4 can't go green
why: The text measures well above the floor, and the colour tests still guard it.
